==================
NS_ASSUME_NONNULL around an interface
==================

NS_ASSUME_NONNULL_BEGIN

@interface WindowController : NSWindowController

@end

NS_ASSUME_NONNULL_END

---

(translation_unit
  (class_interface
    (identifier)
    (identifier)))

==================
NS_ASSUME_NONNULL_END inside an interface
==================

@interface SDImageFramePool : NSObject

- (void)removeAllFrames;

NS_ASSUME_NONNULL_END

@end

---

(translation_unit
  (class_interface
    (identifier)
    (identifier)
    (method_declaration
      (method_type
        (type_name
          (primitive_type)))
      (identifier))))

==================
Swift actor annotations before an interface
==================

NS_SWIFT_NONISOLATED
@interface SDAnimatedImage : UIImage

@end

NS_SWIFT_UI_ACTOR
@interface SDAnimatedImageView : UIImageView

@end

---

(translation_unit
  (class_interface
    (identifier)
    (identifier))
  (class_interface
    (identifier)
    (identifier)))

==================
Stacked trailing availability attributes on a property
==================

@interface SDWebImageTransition : NSObject

@property (nonatomic, strong, nullable) CAMediaTimingFunction *timingFunction API_UNAVAILABLE(ios, tvos, watchos) API_DEPRECATED("Use SDWebImageAnimationOptions instead", macos(10.10, 10.10));

@end

---

==================
API_DEPRECATED_WITH_REPLACEMENT on a method
==================

@interface UIView_WebCache : NSObject

- (void)sd_cancelCurrentImageLoad API_DEPRECATED_WITH_REPLACEMENT("sd_cancelLatestImageLoad", macos(10.10, 10.10), ios(8.0, 8.0), tvos(9.0, 9.0), watchos(2.0, 2.0));

@end

==================
API_AVAILABLE with version groups on a property
==================

@interface SDWebImageDownloader : NSObject

@property (nonatomic, strong, nullable) NSURLSessionTaskMetrics *metrics API_AVAILABLE(macos(10.12), ios(10.0), watchos(3.0), tvos(10.0));

@end
